Shadow puppet representing Ismar/ Semar. This puppet figure has a tuft of hair attached to and projecting straight up from the centre of its head. It has a white face with red mouth and eye, but the rest of its body, arms, legs and costume is black. There are gold decorations painted onto its costume, however. Both arms are mobile, but attached to only one side of its body. [MOBB [OPS move] 17/05/2016]

Shadow puppet representing Bramah/ Bremara. This puppet figure, with only one moveable arm, has a pink face and body. The legs are patterned with diamonds which are brown, yellow, gold and red and the rest of the costume is blue and red. [MOBB [OPS move] 16/05/2016]

Shadow puppet representing Iskara. This puppet has a black face with a gold body, arms and legs. The costume it is wearing is red, grey-blue, pink and gold. This puppet has only one moveable arm. [MOBB [OPS move] 16/05/2016]

Shadow puppet representing Thakok. This short puppet figure appears to be damaged, possibly by water, so many of the colours are changed. However, there are areas where the original colours are visible. It appears that this figure had a pink face with protruding red mouth, and a once white body. It is wearing a black hat with a red finial, and a costume of red, black and white. Both arms are jointed, but attach to only one side of the figure. [MOBB [OPS move] 17/05/2016]

Shadow puppet representing Kumbayana (Durna as a young man). This puppet figure, which is extremely dirty or damaged, appears to have a (once) pink face with a brown coat with red trim, and black shoes. In one hand he is holding a circlet of red and ?yellow beads. Only one arm (the one not holding the beads) is jointed and mobile. [MOBB [OPS move] 17/05/2016]

Shadow puppet representing Garen. The puppet is mainly black and has the face painted white. There are three rods, one connecting from the leg through to the main body, the other two connected to the arms.

Shadow puppet representing Sathama/ Aswatama. This puppet figure has pink face, body and arms, with long black hair. Its legs are pink with red and black diamonds. The rest of its costume is blue-grey edged in alternating brown and yellow; it also has a component which is pink, black and yellow stripes. Both arms are jointed with sticks attached, however one stick has become adhered to a leg, thereby rendering the arm immobile. [MOBB [OPS move] 17/05/2016]

Shadow puppet representing Pethroe/ Petruk. This puppet figure has a white face, but everything else is black. It has a prominent belly, belly button and nipple. There is a tuft of plant fibre hair projecting from the back of the top of its head. One one side it is wearing a yellow necklet and its costume is edged and highlighted in red. On the reverse, the necklet is red and only a belt is coloured red. [MOBB [OPS move] 17/05/2016]

Shadow puppet representing Sarang Kunee/ Pathi Sangkuni. On one side this figure has black hair, with a yellow and green striped body and a skirt of blue, green, red,  and yellow skirt. The reverse of this puppet is possibly faded, but is much darker in colouring. The paint is quite fragile.

Shadow puppet representing Archoona/ Arjuna. This figure has black hair and face with a yellow body. Its clothing is red with green and yellow patterning. The hide of the upper part of one arm is hardened and slightly curled, and the elbow is stiff. [MOBB [OPS move] 13/05/2016]

Shadow puppet representing Samba, the knight of Paran Garuda. This puppet figure has a white face, black hair and a yellow body. The costume it is wearing is primarily blue and outlined in red.  [MOBB [OPS move] 17/05/2016]

Shadow puppet representing Rajah Thrangangkinchana. This puppet figure has a pink face, with black hair and a yellow body. Its costume is outlined in red within which is blue with gold/yellow decorations. [MOBB [OPS move] 16/05/2016]

Shadow puppet representing Annoman/ Hanoman. This puppet figure has a white body with black hair, and in each hand is a red spike. Each arm is wearing a red armlet and red bracelet. One arm is missing its stick. [MOBB [OPS move] 16/05/2016]

Shadow puppet representing Temongkongchayahchatra/ Jayadrathra, King of Sindura. This puppet has a black face and black hair with a brown body. Its costume is primarily black and red with gold decorations. [MOBB [OPS move] 16/05/2016]
Shadow puppet representing Wara Thurbathai/ Drupadi. The puppet wears a red and blue outfit. The face has been painted black.
Shadow puppet representing Soobraba/ Dewa Supraba, a goddess. She wears a red and gold outfit, and her face is painted black.

Shadow puppet representing Abeyasah. This puppet figure has a red face with a white beard, and is wearing a blue hat, brown coat and blue trousers. It is holding a walking stick in one hand, and only the other hand/arm is jointed and mobile. The lower section of the jointed arm has significant pigment loss. [MOBB [OPS move] 17/05/2016]
Shadow puppet representing Soobalee/ Subali. This puppet figure has a light pink face and body with black hair. Its costume is green and yellow. [MOBB [OPS move] 17/05/2016]
Shadow puppet representing Kola Gnareng/ Cakil. This puppet figure has a blue face and blue hair with a blue and yellow striped body. Its costume is red, yellow and blue. [MOBB [OPS move] 17/05/2016]
